title: Equal benefits.
bodyText: The adoption assistance program referred to in section 346-301 shall provide equal benefits for children regardless of whether federal matching funds for adoption assistance are received by the State.
bodyHtml: [§346-302]  Equal benefits.  The adoption assistance program referred to in section 346-301 shall provide equal benefits for children regardless of whether federal matching funds for adoption assistance are received by the State. [L 1992, c 190, pt of §1]
